## Why the map alone wasn't enough
I'd need the type definitions for StoredMap, its meta, Answer (with its Offer and fix fields) and SavedFix, plus the store's file layout and load code (store.ts above line 56), to describe the saved schema without guessing.

## How to answer
- `concept`: 2–4 plain sentences, no jargon. `how`: the mechanism; define any term you use. `code`: function names, files and lines.
- `refs`: ids of the boxes, arrows and absences your answer relies on.
- If the map doesn't cover it, explore, then put what you found in `add` (new areas, nodes, edges or absences with evidence, same rules as the map; ids must be new). Connect new boxes to existing ones with arrows where the code really connects them.
- `moves`: `focus` on the most relevant id; `highlight` the ids that make up the path that answers the question.
- If they ask for a change, don't edit (you can't). Propose a `fix`: codemap shows it to them on the map, and if they approve, codemap applies exactly your edits and re-checks the map. So describe it as a proposal waiting for their approval, never as something for them to apply by hand.
- The `fix`: `summary` in plain words; `edits` as exact replacements (`find` copied exactly from the file, occurring once; `replace` is the new text); `creates` for new files. If the fix creates a connection between two boxes, fill `connects` with `from`, `to`, a short `label`, and `evidenceFile` + `evidenceText` (text that will appear in the new code). Keep fixes small and in the style of the surrounding code.
- `followUps`: up to 3 short next questions.

## Evidence rules (a program checks every claim; anything it can't confirm is shown as unconfirmed)
- Every box and arrow cites at least one line: `file` (repo-relative), `line` (1-based), and `text` copied exactly from that line. A distinctive fragment of 10–80 characters works best.
- A box that is a function or method gets `symbol`: "<file>#<name>", named the way the checker names it: methods as Class.method, object members as obj.member ("src/db.ts#db.update"), a function inside another function as outer.inner, and a function in the object a factory returns as factory.member. When a list of functions by file is given, copy the name from it. If you aren't sure of the name, leave `symbol` out: the box is still checked by its cited line.
- Arrow `kind`: `calls` when a function in the from box literally calls the function in the to box; `request` when an HTTP call in the from box hits a route handled by the to box; `imports`; `then` for anything else (events, ordering). The checker verifies calls, request and imports against the code, so use them only when literally true.
- Never cite or read secret files (.env, keys).

3	// answers, and where each proposed fix stands, so a reopened map still has its conversation.
4	import * as fs from 'node:fs';
5	import * as path from 'node:path';
6	import { parseMap, slugify, type CodeMap } from '@codemap/core';
7	import type { Answer } from './explainer';
8	
9	export type MapMeta = {
10	  id: string;
11	  question: string;
12	  createdAt: string;
13	  updatedAt: string;
14	  commit: string | null;
15	  makerSession: string | null;
16	  explainerSession: string | null;
17	  cost: number;
18	  /** The map this one was started from, when a question there turned out to be about something else. */

21	/** Where a proposed fix stands. Undo isn't saved: it needs the files as they were, which only the running server has. */
22	export type SavedFix = { status: 'proposed' | 'applied' | 'rejected'; edgeId?: string | null; closed?: string[] };
23	export type StoredMap = { meta: MapMeta; map: CodeMap; answers?: Answer[]; fixes?: Record<string, SavedFix> };
24	
25	const ID = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,80}$/;
26	
27	export function createStore(root: string) {
28	  const base = path.join(root, '.codemap');
29	  const dir = path.join(base, 'maps');
30	
31	  const ensure = () => {
32	    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
33	    const ignore = path.join(base, '.gitignore');
34	    // Maps are worth committing; scratch output is not.
35	    if (!fs.existsSync(ignore)) fs.writeFileSync(ignore, 'fixes/\nws-modules/\n');
36	  };
37	  const file = (id: string) => {
38	    if (!ID.test(id)) throw new Error(`Not a map id: ${id}`);
39	    return path.join(dir, `${id}.json`);
40	  };
41	
42	  return {
43	    dir,
44	    get(id: string): StoredMap | null {
45	      let raw: { meta?: MapMeta; map?: unknown; answers?: unknown; fixes?: unknown };
46	      try {
47	        raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file(id), 'utf8'));
48	      } catch {
49	        return null;
50	      }
51	      const parsed = parseMap(raw.map);
52	      if (!parsed.ok || !raw.meta) return null;
53	      // Maps saved before answers were kept have neither; a hand-edited file loses only what doesn't look right.
54	      const answers = Array.isArray(raw.answers)
55	        ? (raw.answers as Answer[]).filter((a) => a && typeof a.id === 'string' && typeof a.question === 'string' && Array.isArray(a.added))
56	        : [];
57	      const fixes = raw.fixes && typeof raw.fixes === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw.fixes) ? (raw.fixes as Record<string, SavedFix>) : {};
58	      return { meta: raw.meta, map: parsed.map, answers, fixes };
59	    },
60	    save(stored: StoredMap): void {
61	      ensure();
62	      const target = file(stored.meta.id);
63	      const tmp = `${target}.tmp`;
64	      fs.writeFileSync(tmp, `${JSON.stringify(stored, null, 2)}\n`);
65	      fs.renameSync(tmp, target);
66	    },
67	    list(): MapMeta[] {
68	      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
69	      return fs
70	        .readdirSync(dir)
71	        .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json'))
72	        .flatMap((f) => {
73	          try {
74	            const meta = (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), 'utf8')) as { meta?: MapMeta }).meta;
75	            return meta ? [meta] : [];
76	          } catch {
77	            return [];
78	          }
79	        })
80	        .sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt));
81	    },
82	    /** A new id for a question, unique among saved maps and ids already handed out. */
83	    newId(question: string, taken: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): string {
84	      const base = slugify(question);
85	      for (let i = 1; ; i++) {
86	        const id = i === 1 ? base : `${base}-${i}`;
87	        if (!taken.has(id) && !fs.existsSync(file(id))) return id;
88	      }
89	    },
90	  };
91	}

201	  function takeOffer(mapId: string, answerId: string, choice: 'map' | 'words' | null): { id?: string; ok: true } {
202	    if (!choice) throw new HttpError(400, 'Choose a new map or an answer in words.');
203	    const stored = store.get(mapId);
204	    const a = stored?.answers?.find((x) => x.id === answerId);
205	    if (!stored || !a?.offer || a.offer.status !== 'pending') throw new HttpError(404, 'No such question waiting for a choice.');
206	    if (choice === 'words' && jobs.has(mapId)) throw new HttpError(409, 'Claude is still working on this map. Try again when it finishes.');
207	    const newId = choice === 'map' ? startMap(a.offer.question, { mapId, question: stored.map.question }) : null;
208	    const updated: Answer = { ...a, offer: { ...a.offer, status: choice === 'map' ? 'mapped' : 'answered', mapId: newId } };
209	    store.save({ ...stored, answers: (stored.answers ?? []).map((x) => (x.id === answerId ? updated : x)) });
210	    broadcast({ type: 'answerUpdate', mapId, answer: updated });
211	    if (choice === 'words') startAsk(mapId, a.question, {}, { wordsOnly: true });
212	    return newId ? { id: newId, ok: true } : { ok: true };
